//==
// # Error propagation

// How uncertainty is propagated through a computation: first-order Taylor
// (Linear), sampled with the given count and deterministic seed
// (MonteCarlo), or sigma points (Unscented).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Propagation_of_uncertainty)
type ErrorPropagation
    = Linear
    | MonteCarlo(SampleCount: Integer, Seed: Integer)
    | Unscented;
